plan: Drive: from Mica Creek, about 138 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).

Ride: 5.3 km on B-5.6, B-5.8 by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 290 m N, climb about 9 m.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
